page.help: Counters are channels whose name shows a live number, like "Members: 1234". Mewvo updates them every 15 minutes. The counting game is a channel where members count up together, one number per message.

list.title: Server stats counters
list.help: Mewvo makes the channel for you. You can also do this with /serverstats create in Discord.
list.helpNoAdmin: Mewvo makes the channel for you. You can also do this with /serverstats create in Discord. To create channels you need the Administrator permission in this server.
list.deleteConfirm: Delete this counter and its channel?

create.title: New counter
create.channelTypeHelp: A voice channel is the usual choice: it sits in the list and shows the number.
create.categoryHelp: A category is a folder of channels. The counter channel is made in it.
create.allUsed: Every kind of counter is already in use. You can have one of each.

counting.title: Counting game
counting.help: Members take turns writing the next number. Starting or restarting the game here resets the count and the leaderboard. You can also do this with /count setup in Discord.
counting.label: Counting game:
counting.channelHelp: Use a channel just for counting.
counting.systemHelp: How the numbers are written. Decimal (normal numbers) is the usual choice.
counting.restart: Start again in this channel (count goes back to 1)

action.renameLater: The channel name updates on the next scheduled run.
action.renameFailed: The channel could not be renamed now; it updates on the next scheduled run.
action.deleteFailed: The counter channel could not be deleted (permissions?).
